summary.intent: Complete Phase 23 (Rust SDK Extraction) gap closure execution, run a security review on the extracted Rust crates, increase test coverage, and get PR #352 merged-ready by resolving CI failures and review comments.
summary.outcome: All 8 plans in Phase 23 executed and verified. PR #352 created with 163 new unit tests, security findings fixed, multiple rounds of CodeRabbit/Copilot review comments resolved, and persistent CI failures on Windows cargo check and cross-language vector parity addressed through vendored fuser patching and build ordering fixes.

repo: The workspace uses [patch.crates-io] for a vendored fuser crate at apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/fuser/ — this causes Cargo to resolve and attempt to compile fuser for ALL workspace members regardless of feature activation, even on Windows where fuser is Unix-only.

cipherbox-fuse has default = ["fuse"] feature that pulls in fuser/unicode-normalization. When cipherbox-desktop depends on it without default-features = false, the fuse feature activates transitively.

Feature definitions referencing dep:fuser fail on Windows when fuser is placed under [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] — Cargo cannot resolve dep: references in feature definitions for platform-excluded deps.
The desktop crate's winfsp feature enables cipherbox-fuse/winfsp but NOT cipherbox-fuse/fuse — correct separation for cross-platform builds.
All KeyState and CipherBoxFS key fields already use Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> with proper clear() on logout/unmount — strong baseline zeroization discipline.
HKDF uses domain separation correctly across all 5 derivation contexts. API client redacts tokens/keys in Debug impls.
generate_ed25519_keypair callers were wrapping return value in redundant Zeroizing::new(ipns_private_key.clone()) — private key was not zeroized at source.
ed25519-dalek requires explicit zeroize feature flag to zero SigningKey on drop — not enabled by default.
The CI runs cargo llvm-cov --workspace on Linux for Rust coverage reporting to Codecov.
Cross-language vector parity tests: @cipherbox/core imports @cipherbox/crypto types for DTS generation — must build crypto before core in CI.

code.finding: generate_ed25519_keypair returned bare Vec<u8> for private key — changed to Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>
Callers wrapped generate_ed25519_keypair return in redundant Zeroizing::new() — simplified after return type change
ipns_private_key.try_into() for Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> -> [u8;32] requires .into_inner().try_into() since Zeroizing doesn't impl TryInto<[u8;32]>
Copy-paste bug: app_version field was being set to device_info.device_id instead of device_info.app_version — device_info partially moved above so fields needed pre-extraction
fetch_and_populate_folder and resolve_file_pointers_blocking were dead code (existed in both macOS/Linux and Windows variants) — removed 181 lines
IpnsPublishRequest derived Debug, leaking encrypted IPNS key material — replaced with custom Debug impl that redacts sensitive fields
Key length cast as u8 without validation — 32-byte length check added; encode_libp2p_public_key now returns Result
Vendored fuser lib.rs split into lib.rs (cfg-gated include!) + lib_impl.rs (unix-only content) to make the crate a no-op on Windows without removing the [patch.crates-io] entry
Temp directory cleanup was happening before unmount — moved after unmount (and after all early return paths)
get_bytes method existed but was never called — removed as dead code

workflow: When an agent disconnects mid-execution, check git log for completed commits before re-running — avoids duplicate work. Only bookkeeping (SUMMARY.md, STATE.md, ROADMAP.md) may be missing.
1Password SSH signing fails intermittently on first attempt but usually succeeds on retry — worth retrying 2-3 times before escalating.
CodeRabbit generates new review threads after each push — running /resolve-pr-comments multiple times in a session is normal for active PRs.
Cargo [patch.crates-io] resolves patched crates workspace-wide regardless of feature activation — vendored Unix-only crates must be made compilable on all platforms at the source level.
cargo llvm-cov --workspace covers all workspace members — adding tests to any crate automatically improves Codecov reporting without CI changes.
Parallel pnpm --filter builds can fail when packages have build-time dependencies on each other — sequential && is safer for interdependent packages.

friction: 1Password SSH agent failed consistently on first commit attempt, requiring 2-3 retries each time — affected multiple commits throughout the session.

Windows cargo check required 4 separate fix attempts: (1) build.rs early return, (2) cfg(unix) target-gated deps, (3) default-features = false on desktop dep, (4) finally splitting vendored fuser lib.rs into unix-only include — each attempt revealed a different layer of the Cargo [patch.crates-io] resolution problem.

The root cause of Windows failures (Cargo always resolves [patch.crates-io] entries regardless of feature activation) is a Cargo limitation with no clean built-in workaround — required invasive vendored code modification.
Cross-language parity CI failure required two attempts: first added pnpm version (missing), then fixed build order (core depends on crypto for DTS).
CodeRabbit re-raised the ECIES min-size check comment 3 separate times across different review rounds.
Agent API connection error (ConnectionRefused) mid-execution of plan 23-08, requiring manual resume and bookkeeping.
open_items: AES-CTR client-side integrity verification: client doesn't verify IPFS CID after fetching bytes — an attacker controlling the relay could serve tampered ciphertext (identified in security review, not fixed in this session)
file_ipns_private_key in write_ops.rs uses ed25519_dalek directly (not generate_ed25519_keypair) and stores as plain Vec<u8> — separate from the folder IPNS key fix, flagged but out of scope

The vendored fuser lib_impl.rs split is a hack — the proper fix would be to make [patch.crates-io] conditional or remove the fuser patch entirely once the desktop no longer needs the custom vendored version

Security review medium findings (ed25519-dalek zeroize and generate_ed25519_keypair return type) were fixed, but 4 remaining medium/low findings documented in .planning/security/REVIEW-2026-03-24-phase23.md were not addressed in this session
